But I would argue that this does not meet the license inclusion guidelines https://github.com/spdx/license-list-XML/blob/main/DOCS/license-inclusion-principles.md in the part that 
 > The license has actual, substantial use such that it is likely to be encountered. Substantial use may be demonstrated via use in many projects

This is -1 from me.
You can still use user-defined LicenseRef-* ID as defined at https://spdx.github.io/spdx-spec/v3.0.1/annexes/spdx-license-expressions/
